name: eu_timing_moisture_rule_v1
description: Timing + moisture rule: silage if the drop comes soon enough after the field's own peak OR the canopy is still wet just before it; thresholds fitted on Austria 2024 only
probability: Platt-calibrated for a 50/50 training class balance
rule_text: silage if harv_days_since_peak <= 26.7 OR pre_ndmi >= 0.213; no harvest detected -> score 0.46
effective_rule: silage if harv_days_since_peak <= 28.6 (OR pre_ndmi test as in rule)
